what: Drag to explore boards larger than the window (evidence board·map·moodboard). While dragging, the board follows the hand exactly and its velocity catches up with the hand velocity by 1 − e^(−25·dt). On release it glides at that velocity and slows with e^(−5·dt), and when the remaining distance to the board edge is within 10% of the window width it slows by that ratio and settles softly at the edge. Movement beyond 2% of window width·height counts as a drag.

options.smoothing: Speed at which it catches up with the hand while dragging, default 25
options.edge: Edge falloff width (ratio of window width), default .1
options.speed: Pixels the panel moves per 1px of interaction, default 1
options.threshold: Movement produced by dragging (window ratio), default .02

note: Dragging is the whole job of this part, so touch scrolling is blocked over the board (touch-action: none) — keep the board from covering the full screen height and let page scrolling happen outside it. A press produced by releasing after a drag is blocked from reaching links inside the board.
